rationale: The surface truncates the compound surname in references to Madame or M. Berthier d'Eyzelles.
The surface is only the first-name component of John Greenleaf Whittier in the focal occurrence.
The bare shared surname omits the titles needed to distinguish Mrs. Bennet from Mr. Bennet in this passage.
The surface omits Company from the institutional name Worthington Mercantile Company.
Treasury is only a modifier within the financial-instrument mentions Treasury paper and U.S. Treasury debt.
Moloch Rising is named as a dark secret but could denote an event, project, text, or supernatural entity without further identification.
ENIDE occurs here as part of the bibliographic title EREC ET ENIDE rather than as a character mention.
Before is a temporal preposition and does not refer to an entity.
Yggrath is an individually named magical creature that slumbers, stirs, and exerts influence.
Brer is an honorific-like prefix shared by several animal characters and must be expanded to the relevant full name.
Kapchack is an individually named sapient animal character described as being in love.
The Black Ships denotes a coordinated hostile fleet collectively positioning itself and seeking conquest.
Baron is only the title portion of the individual name Baron Stott-Wartenheim.
OBELISK is explicitly identified as a monolithic alien artifact rather than a sentient character.
On is a preposition in the phrase on my own clear conscience and has no entity referent.
The Tiger is an individually identified enemy tank ace who is explicitly referred to as he.
Don is only the title portion of the individual's name Don Luis.
Chrysalis Station is explicitly a massive temporal-anchor structure, not an individuated sentient entity.
Longwell is the surname used for the individually referable seminary president Miss Jessie Longwell.
At is a preposition in the phrase at the same time and does not denote an entity.
Metropolitan is an incomplete modifier shared across names such as Metropolitan Club, Metropolitan Opera, and Metropolitan Art Gallery.
The is merely the determiner of a larger nominal mention and cannot independently identify its referent.
Saint is only the first component of the place name Saint Claude in the focal occurrence.
Company is only part of the coordinated faction name Company of Jehu.
The first-person pronoun is a valid reference to the princess, but the supplied span incorrectly includes adjacent comma punctuation.
